content.title: Justin Bieber's Coachella set: What time does he perform on April 18?
content.text: POP-CULTUREJustin Bieber at Coachella 2026: What time does he perform on April 18? Alex McDanielFor The WinApril 18, 2026, 1:57 p.m. ET0:33/0:43Keep WatchingJustin Bieber will perform on Coachella's main stage at 11:25 p.m. PT on Saturday, April 18, 2026. Bieber is headlining Saturday's Coachella lineup for the festival's second and final weekend, which also includes performances from The Strokes, Addison Rae, PinkPantheress and Kacey Musgraves.How to watch Justin Bieber at Coachella 2026Coachella is livestreaming most of Saturday's sets on YouTube. You can also watch via the Coachella Livestream app, which syncs to your time zone.Which songs will Justin Bieber perform at Coachella 2026?Bieber's 90-minute set on April 11 was significantly understated, first performing several Swag and Swag II tracks before transitioning into an impromptu session of fan song requests and a YouTube singalong featuring older tracks like "Beauty and a Beat," "Never Say Never" and more of his earlier hits. While Coachella performers typically maintain their set lists for both weekends, there is always room for adjustments.
